rows.note: Use this as the default casual way to mean “of course” or “certainly,” rather than for natural manner or inherent qualities.

example.english: Naturally, it'll be fine, so don't worry.
example.jyutping: gang2 hai6 dak1 laa1 nei5 fong3 sam1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when describing someone doing something in a natural, unforced manner.

example.english: They naturally chatted with everyone, as if they had known each other for a long time.
example.traditional: 佢自然咁同大家傾偈，好似識咗好耐咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zi6 jin4 gam2 tung4 daai6 gaa1 king1 gai2 hou2 ci5 sik1 zo2 hou2 noi6 gam2

rows.note: Use this for an inherent quality or tendency that someone has from birth, rather than for a manner of acting or “of course.”

example.english: I am naturally shy and don't know what to say when I meet strangers.
example.traditional: 我天生怕醜，見到陌生人就唔識講嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tin1 saang1 paa3 cau2 gin3 dou2 maak6 saang1 jan4 zau6 m4 sik1 gong2 je5
